poses.label: Idle — sniffing a pie
poses.initialPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one isolated PNG mascot pose for the PiePal kiosk.
Reference image 1 is the approved mascot. Preserve this exact dinosaur identity and illustration style while changing ONLY its pose and the necessary prop described below. Keep the distinctive very large rounded right-facing head with long oval snout, tiny cocoa oval eye and small nostril, outlined cream oval cheek patch, tiny simple mouth, chubby pear-shaped green body with cream belly, very short arms, stubby legs with cream oval soles, long thick tapered tail to the left, and the same rounded triangular dark green dorsal spikes. Retain the proportions, thick smooth dark cocoa outlines, rounded joins, and playful simplicity of the reference. Do not redesign the head, add eyebrows or large eyes, add extra limbs, clothing or accessories beyond the requested prop, or turn it into a generic baby dinosaur.
Color palette: body green #6BBF59, belly/soles/cheek warm cream #FFF8EC, spikes deep green #2E7D4F, outlines/eye/mouth cocoa #3B2416, pie crust gold #E8A94B and darker crust #B9772A. Clean flat vector-like raster artwork. Solid color fills, no gradients, no paper texture, no glow, no shadows, no 3D.
Format: landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, transparent all the way to the outline, clean antialiased edges, no background color or checkerboard baked in. Single complete mascot, centered with around 7% padding, fill most of the canvas. Keep the full tail, spikes, feet and props in frame. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no UI mockup.

Pose for IDLE / ATTRACT: the same dinosaur seated with its body leaning eagerly forward toward the right, snout tilted slightly up as it sniffs a delicious small whole golden pie held up by its tiny arms just below its nose. Its visible eye is gently closed in a contented small cocoa arc instead of the open oval, and a single tiny cream droplet at the mouth suggests drooling. Show two short curved cocoa aroma lines above the pie. The tail rests along the ground to the left and both stubby feet sit forward. Expression is hungry and delighted. Make the lean and sniffing action clearly different from the upright original. Remove the reference's floating hearts.
poses.finalPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided PiePal idle dinosaur PNG with ONE tiny facial correction only. There are currently two mouth-like marks: a small smile close to the nostril at the tip of the snout, and a curved mouth with a droplet lower down toward the cheek. REMOVE the lower curved mouth AND its droplet completely, filling that small area with matching uninterrupted green. KEEP the single tiny smile near the nostril as the only mouth. Keep everything else exactly as it is: closed happy eye, cream cheek, head silhouette, green color, seated leaning pose, tiny arms holding the pie below its nose, curved aroma lines, pie, tail, feet, spikes, outlines, all proportions and composition. Do not add or change any other facial feature. Maintain genuine alpha transparency outside the illustration. Output one transparent PNG, same 1536x1024 dimensions, no background, no glow, no added text.
